theme: 3 terms for reacting to a view's life: it appears, a value changes and async work starts

terms.definition: A modifier that runs code when a view appears on screen.
terms.example: Log the screen name in onAppear.

terms.definition: A modifier that runs code when a watched value changes.
terms.example: Save the draft in onChange when the text changes.

terms.definition: A modifier that starts async work when a view appears and cancels it when the view goes away.
terms.example: Load the notes in a Task Modifier.

video.title: onAppear, onChange & Task Modifier | Day 149
video.description:
Learn to explain how a SwiftUI view reacts to appearing and changes: onAppear, onChange & Task Modifier, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
onAppear - A modifier that runs code when a view appears on screen.
onChange - A modifier that runs code when a watched value changes.
Task Modifier - A modifier that starts async work when a view appears and cancels it when the view goes away.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain onAppear, onChange & Task Modifier in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.

onAppear - A modifier that runs code when a view appears on screen.
한국어: 온어피어: 뷰가 화면에 나타날 때 코드를 실행하는 모디파이어

onChange - A modifier that runs code when a watched value changes.
한국어: 온체인지: 지켜보는 값이 바뀔 때 코드를 실행하는 모디파이어

Task Modifier - A modifier that starts async work when a view appears and cancels it when the view goes away.
한국어: 태스크 모디파이어: 뷰가 나타날 때 비동기 작업을 시작하고 사라지면 취소하는 모디파이어

landscape.hook: Can you explain onAppear, onChange and Task Modifier in English?

dialogue.title: React to a screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want to print a message when the screen opens.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use onAppear. It runs code when the view appears on screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. It runs every time the view appears, for example when the user comes back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I want to react when the name changes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use onChange with the value to watch, like `name` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used onAppear to check the name, but it never saw the new name.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. onAppear runs only when the view shows. For changes, use onChange.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And I need to load data from the network.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the Task Modifier. It starts async work when the view appears.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What happens if the user leaves before it finishes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The Task Modifier cancels the work for you. That makes it a good fit for loading.
Log the screen name in onAppear.
